import json
from harness import *
fails=[]
LIM=json.dumps({'images':16,'cells':262144,'units':1024,'contexts':32768,'connections':4096,'packets':32768,'files':8192})
def raw(text, want, name):
    out,_=call(text if isinstance(text,bytes) else text.encode())
    if not check(name,out,want): fails.append(name)
def J(events, services='[{"name":"A","label":1}]', limits=LIM):
    return '{"jobs":[{"services":%s,"limits":%s,"events":%s}]}'%(services,limits,json.dumps(events))
INVALID={'error':'invalid'}
JOBINV={'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]}

# ---- envelope -------------------------------------------------------------
raw(b'\xef\xbb\xbf{"jobs":[]}', INVALID, 'BOM')
raw(b'{"jobs":[]}\xef\xbb\xbf', INVALID, 'trailing BOM')
raw(b'{"jobs":[]}', {'results':[]}, 'empty jobs')
raw(b'{"jobs":[]} ', {'results':[]}, 'trailing space')
raw(b'{"jobs":[]}\n\t\r ', {'results':[]}, 'trailing ws')
raw(b'{"jobs":[]}{}', INVALID, 'trailing json')
raw(b'{"jobs":[]}{', INVALID, 'trailing malformed')
raw(b'[]', INVALID, 'top-level array')
raw(b'{}', INVALID, 'missing jobs')
raw(b'{"jobs":[],"extra":1}', INVALID, 'extra top key')
raw(b'{"jobs":{}}', INVALID, 'jobs not list')
raw(b'{"jobs":[],}', INVALID, 'trailing comma')
raw(b'', INVALID, 'empty input')
raw(b'{"jobs":[]', INVALID, 'unterminated')
raw(b'\xff\xfe{"jobs":[]}', INVALID, 'bad utf8')
raw('{"jobs":[{"services":[{"name":"\ud800","label":1}],"limits":%s,"events":[]}]}'%LIM, INVALID, 'lone surrogate in name is job-invalid... but json cannot encode')

# duplicates
raw(b'{"jobs":[],"jobs":[]}', INVALID, 'dup top key')
raw(b'{"jobs":[{"services":[{"name":"A","label":1,"name":"B"}],"limits":'+LIM.encode()+b',"events":[]}]}', INVALID, 'dup nested key')
raw(J([{'op':'inspect','op':'inspect'}]), INVALID, 'dup event key')

# numbers
raw(b'{"jobs":[],"n":NaN}', INVALID, 'NaN key extra')
raw(J([{'op':'stage','epoch':float('nan'),'policy':''}]).replace('NaN','NaN'), INVALID, 'nan')
raw('{"jobs":[{"services":[{"name":"A","label":1}],"limits":%s,"events":[{"op":"commit","epoch":1e400}]}]}'%LIM, INVALID, 'float overflow')
raw('{"jobs":[{"services":[{"name":"A","label":1}],"limits":%s,"events":[{"op":"commit","epoch":1e-400}]}]}'%LIM, JOBINV, 'float underflow -> job invalid')
raw('{"jobs":[{"services":[{"name":"A","label":1}],"limits":%s,"events":[{"op":"commit","epoch":1.0}]}]}'%LIM, JOBINV, 'float epoch')
raw('{"jobs":[{"services":[{"name":"A","label":1}],"limits":%s,"events":[{"op":"commit","epoch":true}]}]}'%LIM, JOBINV, 'bool epoch')
raw('{"jobs":[{"services":[{"name":"A","label":1}],"limits":%s,"events":[{"op":"commit","epoch":%s}]}]}'%('9'*4301,), INVALID, 'int 4301 digits')
raw('{"jobs":[{"services":[{"name":"A","label":1}],"limits":%s,"events":[{"op":"commit","epoch":%s}]}]}'%('9'*4300,), JOBINV, 'int 4300 digits -> job invalid (out of range)')
raw('{"jobs":[{"services":[{"name":"A","label":1}],"limits":%s,"events":[{"op":"inspect"}],"x":%s}]}'%('9'*4301,), INVALID, 'long int elsewhere')

# nesting depth
nested='0'
for _ in range(62): nested='['+nested+']'
raw('{"jobs":['+nested+']}', JOBINV, 'depth 64 job invalid')
raw('{"jobs":[['+nested+']]}', INVALID, 'depth 65')
deep='0'
for _ in range(70): deep='['+deep+']'
raw('{"jobs":[{"services":[{"name":"A","label":1}],"limits":%s,"events":'+deep+'}]}', INVALID, 'deep events')
raw('{"jobs":['+'['*70+']'*70+']}', INVALID, 'deep brackets')
raw('{"jobs":[{"services":[{"name":"[[[[","label":1}],"limits":%s,"events":[{"op":"inspect"}]}]}'%LIM, JOBINV, 'brackets in strings do not count')

# jobs count
raw('{"jobs":['+','.join('{"services":[{"name":"A","label":1}],"limits":%s,"events":[]}'%LIM for _ in range(4))+']}',
    {'results':[{'events':[]}]*4}, '4 jobs ok')
raw('{"jobs":['+','.join('{"services":[{"name":"A","label":1}],"limits":%s,"events":[]}'%LIM for _ in range(5))+']}',
    INVALID, '5 jobs')

print('failures:',fails)
PYEOF
